messages:
Maria: quick sync — we need to pick an approach for internal transport: put a 'fastpath' in the gateway (L7 routing + lightweight proxying) or rely on transport adaptors on callers that talk proto/grpc directly. main constraints:  p99 tail latency under 40ms for short calls, accurate quota attribution per tenant/route, and minimal rollout friction.
Ajay: can you share where we saw the latency spikes? client-side or gateway egress?
Maria: mostly gateway egress when request rates hit bursts. clients are fine in isolation. gateway CPU climbs and we see queuing in envoy filters.
Lena: telemetry angle — if we do caller adaptors, Console loses a single unified place to show per-route latency unless adaptors emit consistent metrics. that's an ops burden.
Tom: curious about complexity tradeoff. gateway fastpath means adding special-case code paths (bypass heavy middleware) vs adaptors means many SDKs and services to maintain. either way we need a compatibility story.
Kevin: hybrid idea: gateway does lightweight header-based fastpath for trusted services (x-internal-fastpath: true) + adaptors for external/legacy. keeps most telemetry centralized.
Ajay: hybrid seems reasonable. real question: how do we ensure quota attribution is correct if bypassing some middleware? we need consistent token/tenant propagation.
Maria: right — proposal: gateway fastpath still enforces auth & quota at ingress, then forwards with opaque tenant header to backend so backend adaptors don't need to re-check for attribution. backend still validates signature for security fallback.
Lena: can we get Console to tag fastpath traces differently? we should be able to filter by route+fastpath flag and still show end-to-end spans.
Tom: rollout UX: prefer a canary toggle per-service in Console. example: "fastpath.enabled": off by default, can toggle to 2% traffic for service X. if latency regressions, auto-revert.
Maria: agreed. pseudo-config we discussed:
```
routes:
  - name: payments.lookup
    fastpath: true
    fastpath_allowlist: ["payments-svc", "billing-svc"]
    quota_check: ingress
    telemetry_tags: ["fastpath:v1"]
```
This keeps quota at gateway and annotates telemetry.
Kevin: question: what about streaming/gRPC long-lived connections? fastpath only makes sense for unary short calls. adaptors still needed for streaming.
Ajay: for streaming we keep direct gRPC channels and let adaptors handle batching, backpressure. document that in the SDKs.
Lena: +1. I'll add telemetry tags and dashboard widgets: per-route p50/p95/p99, fastpath ratio, and canary signal (error + latency).
Maria: sound plan. Action items: (1) Ajay: prototype gateway fastpath header + quota passthrough (2) Kevin: write security fallback spec for tenant propagation (3) Lena: dashboard mockups and canary UX copy (4) Tom: outline rollout playbook.
deploy-bot: canary started for payments.lookup fastpath at 2% — rollout id 2026-05-03T12:09:01Z
Ajay: starting prototype branch now, ping when infra config bits are ready.
Maria: thanks all — let's sync tomorrow morning if blockers show up.
